request.recipient: Intersect, on behalf of the vendor, with funds directed to the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stated in the document.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Intersect Technical Steering Committee Support for 12 months across community engagement, protocol governance, and independent technical review.

claims.claim: Intersect's Technical Steering Committee requests $298,250, equivalent to 1,193,000 ADA, to support activities for 12 months.
The budget is allocated as 256,000 ADA for WP 1, 832,000 ADA for WP 2, and 105,000 ADA for WP 3.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
All expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds will be returned to the Cardano treasury.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not at submission breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold and may include deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.
Intersect will administer the funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisignature permissions, and an external Oversight Committee.

The Technical Steering Committee has not received Cardano Treasury funding within the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA through listed prior governance actions.
The TSC support work is presented as foundational technical governance infrastructure aligned with protocol reliability, DRep decision-making, and treasury stewardship goals.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of Intersect TSC support, divided across technical coordination, protocol governance, and a pilot technical review programme, with smart-contract administration, external oversight, audit references, prior-funding disclosure, and a commitment to account for spending and return unspent funds.
